blocks.text: Quezon City 5th District Rep. Patrick Michael Vargas presents the formal complaint and digital evidence before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) on Friday, Oct. 16. (Photo from the office of Quezon City 5th District Rep. Patrick Michael Vargas) MANILA, Philippines — Quezon City 5th District Rep. Patrick Michael Vargas filed a cyber libel complaint against alleged fake social media pages posing as news sites before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI). Vargas, in a statement released on Saturday, said that he personally turned over the formal complaint and digital evidence to NBI Director Melvin Matibag at the NBI headquarters in […]...
